description: Validation gate for the NMSE loss fix. gpt2-large is the model that collapsed (L0 91816 -> 0.9 by step 1856, rel_fro 0.999). Falsifiable prediction: with l_recon = sum((yhat-y)^2)/sum(y^2) and lambda_sparsity=6.3e-4, L0 should settle in the hundreds rather than ->1, and rel_fro should fall well below 0.99. Also yields post-TF32 throughput on the real path. 1 node x 2 GPU.
